cover_headline: Trump Says Deportation Policy Was 'Too Tough' in Post-Midterm Interview
facts: Trump said he would love to do something on immigration with the incoming Democratic Congress
About an hour after the interview, Trump replaced chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller, the architect of the deportation policy
No executive order, regulation or enforcement guidance accompanied the interview

quote.text: I think it was too tough... I think it might be too tough.
quote.speaker: President Donald Trump

end.headline: Trump Says Deportation Policy Was 'Too Tough' in Post-Midterm Interview
end.line: Trump's first sit-down since the midterm defeat — an hour after recording, he made Stephen Miller chief of staff.
